activities.correctAnswer: Sarajevo was the trigger, but the war followed the July Crisis and the mobilization and declarations that came after it.

activities.label: Explain
activities.title: Rival blocs in Europe
activities.body: How did prewar European alliances shape tensions among the major powers?
activities.concept: Prewar European alliances and tensions split major powers into rival armed blocs.
activities.correctAnswer: They divided the major powers into rival armed blocs, which heightened suspicion and made crises more dangerous.
activities.feedback: The key point is rivalry between blocs, not simple friendship among states.
